column1: # guarna1447 key K3, CC BY 4.0 (Brice Dudout, Europe chiffrée, 2026). Rebuilt by aligning the cipher of Guarna's letter of
# 27 May 1447 (ff. 163r-163v) with its late clear copy (ff. 161r-162v, 165r), the pair found by Daniel Bourdeau's survey of
# ital. 1584 copies. Homophonic and in part polyphonic: several values = observed values, most frequent first.
# (null) = null; [word] in the token column = a clear decoy word written inside the cipher (dropped).
